出版者的话

古希腊圣哲亚里士多德曾说：“任何人都会生气，这没什么难的，但若要适时适所地以适当方式对适当对象恰如其分地生气，可就难上加难了。”我们现在讲的情绪管理指的就是要适时适所地对适当对象恰如其分地表达情绪。

现实生活中，人们越来越多地认识到情绪管理能力的重要性，因为这方面能力出众的人往往在各个领域都游刃有余；相反，此项能力差的人，虽然可能很聪明，但做起事来往往很吃力。

情绪管理能力虽部分得益于先天因素，但归根结底还得靠后天的学习和培养。幼儿时期是情绪管理能力培养的黄金时期。一个人在幼儿时期所获得的情绪经验和习惯会在大脑中形成永久的神经联结，对其身心发展影响很长远。

当前，亲子共读情绪管理类图画书这种情绪管理能力培养方式已被广泛认可。优质的图画书好比幸福的种子，通过父母的声音飞进孩子的耳朵里，植根在孩子的心底，施以阳光、雨露就能生根、发芽。

这套有趣的动物图画故事书温情脉脉，每一本都是有针对性地就孩子的某一种情绪话题展开，描绘孩子的心路历程，揭示其走出情绪困扰并解决问题的过程。每一本书都附有幼教专家精心撰写的导读，可作为家长亲子共读时的参考。

让我们在这套书的陪伴下，去享受一段美妙的亲子阅读之旅吧！

page_text_en:
Publisher's Note

The ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle once said: 'Everyone gets angry, and that's not difficult. But to get angry at the right time, in the right place, in the right way, and with the right person, to the right degree—that's difficult indeed.' What we now call emotional management means expressing emotions appropriately, at the right time, in the right place, and toward the right person.

In real life, people are increasingly recognizing the importance of emotional management skills, because those who excel in this area often thrive in various fields; conversely, those who lack this ability, though perhaps intelligent, often struggle when doing things.

While emotional management skills are partly influenced by innate factors, they ultimately rely on learning and cultivation over time. Early childhood is the golden period for developing emotional management skills. The emotional experiences and habits formed during this period create permanent neural connections in the brain, profoundly influencing a person's physical and mental development.

Currently, parent-child reading of emotional management picture books is widely recognized as an effective way to cultivate emotional skills. High-quality picture books are like seeds of happiness, carried into children's ears by parents' voices, taking root in their hearts, and with sunlight and rain, they can grow and flourish.

This series of heartwarming animal picture storybooks is designed to address specific emotional topics for children, illustrating their emotional journeys and revealing how they overcome emotional challenges and solve problems. Each book includes a carefully written guide by early childhood education experts, serving as a reference for parents during shared reading.

Let us enjoy a wonderful parent-child reading journey together with this series!

page_text_en:
Teacher Says to You
Dare to be yourself — that’s the real hero.
What kind of person do you think is a true hero?
Regarding this question, I believe children’s answers differ greatly from adults’! In children’s world, there are fewer rules and restrictions; the heroes in their eyes may be closer to the true meaning of a hero.
“Belingo is a tiny snail who dreams of growing into a strong, big one.” See? The story tells us right from the start: even a tiny snail can have a big dream! A snail with dreams is bound to have a special journey. We were all children once, and we all had various dreams. Are those dreams still in your heart? Have they come true?
Our story’s little protagonist, Belingo, is a snail with a super big dream!
He’s not content with the small space of a snail, he doesn’t want to stay a little guy forever — he wants to see the world above the flowers. With his family’s kindness and care, he made a pair of wings and successfully flew! But before the excitement and pride of flying had faded, he encountered the difficulty of not being able to land. Later, after a bumpy landing and barely catching his breath, he faced another life-threatening crisis! Oh, it’s so thrilling — I bet kids reading this will be so tense they can’t breathe! Haha, what a brave and slightly reckless little fellow! He truly experienced a “fly-on-a-whim journey”!
summary_zh: 本页为绘本的导读页，以‘老师对你说’的形式，引导读者思考‘什么是真英雄’，并介绍了主角小蜗牛贝林戈的梦想与冒险经历，强调勇敢做自己的重要性。

source_file: 超级英雄小蜗牛（3-6 岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
最后，当他总算有惊无险地回到地面时，他感到无比踏实，像个小大人儿似的感慨：“归根结底，小个子也没什么不好的。” 其实，对于一只成长中的小蜗牛来说，这样的冒险经历，是一个自我探索的过程。它留下的，不仅仅是踏实，还有实现梦想的喜悦、满足，以及在认清现实之后，仍然乐于接受现状的勇气。

当然，我们不能忽视家人在孩子成长中的作用。蜗牛爷爷送给贝林戈一本关于花和鸟的书；住在勃艮第的姑妈也鼓励他：“你真是个小天才！” 这些都是帮助孩子守护童年梦想的强大力量！得益于这些鼓励与支持，我们的小蜗牛贝林戈才能运用他超级无敌的想象力和行动力，成功实现了一只蜗牛看花朵上面的世界的梦想！

一个与梦想有关的故事，一次认识自己的冒险之旅，这样一个超级英雄小蜗牛，哪个孩子不想认识呢？

（保定市青年路幼儿园 张艳荣）
page_text_en:
Finally, when he safely returned to the ground, he felt incredibly grounded, reflecting like a little adult: "After all, being small isn't so bad." In fact, for a growing little snail, such an adventure is a process of self-discovery. What it leaves behind is not only a sense of grounding, but also the joy and satisfaction of achieving a dream, and the courage to accept reality with a positive attitude after understanding it.

Of course, we cannot overlook the role of family in a child's growth. Grandpa Snail gave Belingo a book about flowers and birds; his aunt from Burgundy encouraged him: "You're truly a little genius!" These are all powerful forces that help protect a child's childhood dreams! Thanks to this encouragement and support, our little snail Belingo was able to use his super-powered imagination and drive to successfully realize his dream of seeing the world from atop a flower!

A story about dreams, a journey of self-discovery, such a superhero little snail—how could any child not want to meet him?

(Baoding Youth Road Kindergarten, Zhang Yanrong)
